Count of subsets whose five signatures survive deletion S_n from complete H_n is (2^n-n)^2, and special coefficient s^2 t^2 x^(n+1)y^(n+1)z^2 is n versus zero. Independent direct subset enumeration for n=3,4 gave totals 64,256 and unchanged counts 25,144, in agreement. Analytic case partition proves every n>=3, not inferred from these two tests.
